tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List the destinations Simsima covers (countries, regions and global plans), with the entry price and product URL of each.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Search the eSIM plans of a destination (country, region or global), cheapest first, with optional filters on price, data, validity and unlimited data.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Get one eSIM plan by its sku, as returned by search_plans or recommend_plan.

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Recommend the best plan(s) for a trip to a destination, given its length in days and expected data usage (light, medium or heavy).

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Return the URL of a plan's page on simsima.io, with the plan preselected, where the user can review and buy it. No order is placed and no payment is made by this tool. Pass the sku of the chosen plan; with only a destination, the link opens the destination's page without a preselected plan.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Answer "does this eSIM work in <country>" for a destination (country, region or global plan). Accepts a country name or ISO code.

tools.name: get_destination_info
tools.description: Coverage (ISO country codes), mobile operators, top-up availability and entry price for a destination.
